summary: Cross-org secondment: temporary SSH keys, KMS svc-account transfer, and hardware staging checklist
description: Background: HR has approved a 6-week cross-org secondment for an engineer from partner company NovaML (satellite engagement). The secondee (Samira Khan) needs temporary access to a limited set of internal resources to shadow infra work and perform handoff tasks. We must provision ephemeral SSH access, a scoped service account for batch jobs, and ship a staging laptop. This ticket coordinates IT, Security, and Facilities to ensure access is timeboxed, auditable, and hardware is tracked.
impact: Moderate internal risk if access is mis-scoped or not revoked on time. Project schedule depends on the secondee being able to access test clusters and review deployment configs for the first two weeks.
requested_timeline: Requested start date: 2026-03-15. Duration ~6 weeks (expected end: 2026-04-26). All access must auto-expire no later than 2026-04-30.
hardware_items: Power adapter, USB-C dock, Kensington lock
Asset tag: NEW-SSM-7782 (to be recorded in asset inventory)
Preinstalled VPN client and disk encryption; local admin disabled
access_items: Create ephemeral SSH key pair and place public key in jump-host temporary-keys folder with TTL 42 days
Create scoped service account 'svc/secondment/samira' with read-only access to infra configs and limited deploy tokens; encrypt keys into KMS and record key-rotation policy
Add to Okta group 'secondment-infra-read' with automated expiry 2026-04-30
Allow VPN split-tunnel to test clusters only (no prod write access)
Restrict console/session recordings and enable session snapshot for audit
policy_questions: Is using a scoped service account with KMS-encrypted keys acceptable for cross-org contractors per current vendor policy?
Do we require a CN as part of the SSH key naming convention for temporary keys?
Confirm whether Facilities may ship hardware directly to partner address or must route to Redwood office for pickup.
acceptance_criteria: Secondee can SSH to test jump host and access designated test clusters without elevated prod permissions
Service account keys are stored in KMS with documented rotation and a recorded access log
Asset inventory updated with asset tag and shipping/tracking info
All access groups and keys have expiration set and proof of expiry scheduled in IAM audit
audit_requirements: Record initial provisioning steps in the runbook and link to this ticket
Take a snapshot of Okta assignment and KMS ACL after provisioning; store in Confluence under ticket folder
Email confirmation from HR when secondee start date confirmed and when secondee is offboarded
outstanding_dependencies: Facilities to confirm ship-to address and ETA for laptop
Security to approve scoped svc-account ACLs and KMS policy
Networking to open VPN split-tunnel for test clusters in us-east
